about: The old near-realistic 67M tasks (inventory reports/analyses/2026-11-23_analysis_p2-74-old-task-inventory.md; registry src/commute/near_tasks.py) read with every current reading through its owner's code: realistic_reads.Reader.state (re-gating share, untrained SVD and rotated shares, neuron reading at k 64 and k matched, pooled steering with its random draws, k_half), E_b over K at neurons (needed_neurons read_item) and at VPD (needed.needed_set), EAP-IG overlap (eapig_overlap Run). Every state with its matched random (a Gaussian at its per-matrix norms, finetune.random_direction, read over the state's own gain). Filed before any run; never edited after.

twin_rule.pairs: every task with twin_of in near_tasks.TASKS against its real task, on their common seeds: emoticon vs emoticon_http and vs emoticon_eot (seeds 0-2), r1_t534_v369 and r2_t359_v816 vs their ` http` twins (seeds 0-2), many_one vs many_many (seed 0)
twin_rule.rule: near_tasks.separates, per reading and pair, lists in seed order: d_s = real_s - twin_s; its null n_s = |G(real_s) - G(twin_s)|, the same difference between the two states' matched Gaussians (each read over its own state's gain). 'real above' (or 'real below') when every seed has |d_s| > n_s strictly, all of one sign; 'does not separate' when a seed does not or the signs differ; 'no reading' with no seed, unequal lists or any value not finite (a gain under MIN_GAIN, a reading not run). Descriptive: 'separates' means beyond the matched-random spread on all of a pair's seeds
twin_rule.edge_cases_run_before_filing: tests/test_near_tasks.py: three seeds above and below; one seed inside its null; mixed signs; a tie |d| = null and d = 0 with a zero null (not beyond); one seed (applies, n_seeds 1); no seed, unequal lists, a nan and an inf (no reading)
twin_rule.blind_to: a reading that differs between the pair only in its spread across seeds; one Gaussian draw per state sets the null, so a null can be small by chance (the seed-to-seed range is in summary.json beside)
twin_rule.readings: every key of run.py `flat` (share, untrained svd and rotated, neuron k64 and k matched, steering, in log-odds), eb_neurons E_b_K and E_b_K_no_rem and rem_dd_share_K_changed, eb_vpd E_b_K, eapig edge_iou

difficulty: per state: prior (W0's mean log-odds of the target on the read rows), gain (T1 - T0 in log-odds), steps_to_half (retrained states only: the first step whose held-out gain is at least half the step-10 gain; saved states logged none), Pile loss change, KL and size; E272's wide panel at kl_hi beside (score.py panel()).
